notes.description: 25 blocks: recommendation engine RFC with heavy vocabulary overlap across topics (collaborative filtering, content-based, hybrid, online learning, evaluation, A/B testing, monitoring). All topics share terms like model, features, training, accuracy, users, items.
notes.overlap_with_heading: Only gap 1 is shared. 6 of 7 gold boundaries are mid-section topic transitions.
notes.boundary_1: after intro, before Current System section
notes.boundary_4: WITHIN Current System: collab filtering performance discussion ends, cold start problem begins. Both discuss the same model's metrics but shift from strengths to failures.
notes.boundary_10: WITHIN Proposed Architecture: content-based model details end, hybrid scoring layer begins. Both use similar vocabulary (model, score, features) but are architecturally distinct topics.
notes.boundary_14: AT Training Pipeline heading: architecture discussion ends, training begins. Aligns with heading but for the right reason.
notes.boundary_16: WITHIN Training Pipeline: collab filtering training + data quality ends, content-based training begins. Very similar vocabulary (training, model, data, pipeline) but different model.
notes.boundary_21: WITHIN Evaluation Plan: offline evaluation expectations end, A/B test experiment design begins. Both use metrics/accuracy vocabulary but offline eval vs online experiment are different topics.
notes.boundary_23: WITHIN Evaluation Plan: A/B test statistical design ends, production monitoring begins. Both discuss metrics and thresholds but experiment design vs operational monitoring are distinct.
